description:
When a job blocks on a fact nobody has produced yet, the fact's producer is enqueued behind
whatever is already queued. Unrelated work runs first, and meanwhile more jobs block on the
same fact, each of which must be woken again when it lands.

Reduced case: fixtures2/behavior/return_tuple_ladder.fz on fz-afu.10 (debug interp,
--log-telemetry). dbg/1's first activation blocks on FunctionContract(fz_dbg_value/1) and
Recursive(fz_dbg_value/1) (applied step 142). DeriveFunctionContract and
DeriveCallGraphComponent for fz_dbg_value/1 run at steps 194 and 197, behind about 36
alternating main/0 <-> build/1 ladder analyses. Each rung mints a dbg/1 activation, and all
17 block on the same two facts (steps 178-193). The Recursive wake then runs all 17, and
fz_dbg_value's ReturnType wake runs them again: 3 runs per activation where 2 suffice.
dbg/1 analyses 35 -> 51 against fz-afu.3, where the analysis also waited on
InputDemand(fz_dbg_value/1) and so blocked before the ladder was queued.

The same ordering shows up as single runs in fz-afu.10's pins (authorized 2026-09-26):
- enum_predicate_search AnalyzeActivation 551 -> 552: one List.reduce_while/3
  ActivationInputs wake that used to coalesce into a queued run now arrives after it.
- enum_take_drop_split AnalyzeActivation: Recursive wakes 47 -> 49, zero-change 7 -> 8.
- 00420 activation frontier 265 -> 266: Enum.drop_positive/2 is analyzed while its
  accumulator is only empty_list(), minting an intermediate
  Enum.drop_positive_finish/1 ({empty_list(), int}) activation.

Signal: runs per subject and wake causes in work_graph.applied. Close when the ladder's
dbg/1 activations analyze at most twice each (34 in all) and the order-caused runs above
are gone. Needs a paper-first design before any build.
title: A blocked waiter's producers run ahead of unrelated queued work
